title: Midnight in Chernobyl
author: Adam Higginbotham
summary: Adam Higginbotham reconstructs the 1986 Chernobyl explosion and its aftermath, from the flawed reactor design and Soviet secrecy to the firefighters, engineers and officials who dealt with the fallout.
readIf: you want a fast-moving narrative account of how a technical failure and a political system combined.
skipIf: you dislike graphic descriptions of radiation injuries.
